  - region "Simple English explanation of Even and Odd Functions":
    - paragraph: In simple English
    - heading "Understand Even and Odd Functions" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "Even means f(−x)=f(x), as with x^2: (−3)^2=9=3^2. Odd means f(−x)=−f(x), as with x^3: (−2)^3=−8. A function can be neither. A useful rule is Symmetry test: even: f(-x)=f(x), odd: f(-x)=-f(x). You can learn Even and Odd Functions by trying one small example instead of long theory."
    - paragraph: "Compute f(−x) and compare it with f(x) and −f(x). Example: Is f(x)=x^2 even or odd? f(-x)=x^2=f(x). Even. So the answer is even."
    - paragraph: "In real life, physics: Symmetric motion can be even or odd. Watch out: Guessing from the graph title only. Check f(-x) against f(x) and -f(x)."
    - complementary:
      - generic: Try this example
      - paragraph: Is f(x)=x^2 even or odd?
      - generic "Compare your answer"
